items.title: Pierre Merlin Interview, 1961-08-14
items.q: It was just for the few years I played with God Luther, I made improvements because I play every day at that time.

ctx.x: Not really. Not really. How did you learn jazz? A friend who had a teacher, he tried to teach me a little, but it was not very good. I had years of trouble with my lips and... I was not professional too. I made a sketch and painting at that time. It was just for the few years I played with God Luther, I made improvements because I play every day at that time.
Did you hear many American musicians before World War I? Before World War II?
